Shiny applications

Source: vignettes/shiny.Rmd
shiny.Rmd

Browse the Shiny gallery in a new tab, or run the examples here alongside their R source. The first launch downloads R and its dependencies. The apps use the highcharter version documented here.

Basics

Select Sepal or Petal. The same 150 flowers move to their new coordinates. Put highchartOutput("flowers") in the UI and read input$measure inside renderHighchart() to rebuild the plot when the measurement changes.

library(shiny)
library(highcharter)

ui <- fluidPage(
  theme = bslib::bs_theme(version = 5),
  style = "max-width: 48rem;",
  selectInput("measure", "Iris measurements", c("Sepal", "Petal")),
  highchartOutput("flowers", height = "310px")
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$flowers <- renderHighchart({
    hchart(
      iris,
      "scatter",
      hcaes_string(
        x = paste0(input$measure, ".Length"),
        y = paste0(input$measure, ".Width"),
        group = "Species"
      )
    ) |>
      hc_xAxis(title = list(text = "Length (cm)")) |>
      hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "Width (cm)"))
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

Open the app in its own tab

Proxies

The original proxy playground inspired these three examples. Each tab creates its chart once, then uses highchartProxy() to change the chart already on screen.

  • Series. Compare monthly temperatures in Santiago and Tokyo. Toggle Tokyo to add or remove its series. Switch from daily means to daily highs to replace the data by series ID with hcpxy_set_data(). A single hcpxy_redraw() displays both changes. Try the same comparison on polar axes.
  • Points. Add or remove a month of observed air traffic. Turn on the dashed forecast to repeat the last twelve observations one year ahead. The forecast moves with the observations, even when you switch to columns.
  • Layout. Rearrange the same 592 students into a grid, semicircle or circle. hcpxy_update_series() changes the item layout while preserving the counts.
library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(highcharter)

hc_set_theme("hcrt")
palette <- hc_theme("hcrt")$colors

weather <- aggregate(
  cbind(temp_mean, temp_max) ~ city + month,
  transform(city_weather, month = as.integer(format(date, "%m")) - 1L),
  mean
)
city_months <- function(city, measure) {
  rows <- weather[weather$city == city, ]
  data.frame(x = rows$month, y = round(rows[[measure]], 1))
}

counts <- as.numeric(AirPassengers)
months <- seq(
  as.Date("1949-01-01"),
  by = "month",
  length.out = length(counts) + 12L
)
dates <- datetime_to_timestamp(months)
traffic <- data.frame(x = dates[seq_along(counts)], y = counts)
initial <- 24L
# A seasonal naive forecast repeats the last 12 observed months.
outlook <- function(n) {
  data.frame(x = dates[n + seq_len(12L)], y = counts[(n - 11L):n])
}

eyes <- as.data.frame.table(
  margin.table(HairEyeColor, 2),
  responseName = "students"
)

ui <- page_fluid(
  title = "Proxy playground",
  theme = bs_theme(
    version = 5,
    primary = palette[1],
    base_font = c("IBM Plex Sans", "sans-serif"),
    heading_font = c("Alegreya Sans SC", "sans-serif")
  ),
  style = "max-width: 48rem;",
  tags$main(
    class = "py-2",
    navset_underline(
      nav_panel(
        "Series",
        div(
          class = "d-flex align-items-center flex-wrap gap-3 pt-3",
          selectInput(
            "measure",
            "Monthly average of",
            c("Daily mean" = "temp_mean", "Daily high" = "temp_max"),
            width = "11rem"
          ),
          checkboxInput("tokyo", "Compare with Tokyo", TRUE, width = "auto"),
          checkboxInput("polar", "Polar chart", width = "auto")
        ),
        highchartOutput("weather", height = "320px")
      ),
      nav_panel(
        "Points",
        div(
          class = "d-flex align-items-center flex-wrap gap-2 py-3",
          actionButton("add", "Add a month", class = "btn-primary"),
          actionButton("remove", "Remove last month"),
          checkboxInput("forecast", "Show seasonal forecast", width = "auto")
        ),
        radioButtons(
          "type",
          "Observed series",
          c("Line" = "line", "Columns" = "column"),
          inline = TRUE
        ),
        highchartOutput("passengers", height = "300px")
      ),
      nav_panel(
        "Layout",
        div(
          class = "pt-3",
          radioButtons(
            "shape",
            "Arrange the dots",
            c("Grid", "Semicircle", "Circle"),
            inline = TRUE
          )
        ),
        highchartOutput("students", height = "320px")
      )
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$weather <- renderHighchart({
    highchart() |>
      hc_title(text = "City temperatures, 2025") |>
      hc_xAxis(categories = month.abb) |>
      hc_yAxis(
        title = list(text = ""),
        labels = list(format = "{value}°C"),
        tickInterval = 10
      ) |>
      hc_tooltip(shared = TRUE, valueSuffix = " °C", valueDecimals = 1) |>
      hc_add_series(
        city_months("Santiago", "temp_mean"),
        "line",
        hcaes(x, y),
        id = "Santiago",
        name = "Santiago",
        color = palette[1]
      ) |>
      hc_add_series(
        city_months("Tokyo", "temp_mean"),
        "line",
        hcaes(x, y),
        id = "Tokyo",
        name = "Tokyo",
        color = palette[3]
      )
  })

  weather_proxy <- highchartProxy("weather", session)
  observeEvent(
    input$tokyo,
    {
      if (input$tokyo) {
        hcpxy_add_series(
          weather_proxy,
          city_months("Tokyo", input$measure),
          "line",
          hcaes(x, y),
          id = "Tokyo",
          name = "Tokyo",
          color = palette[3]
        )
      } else {
        hcpxy_remove_series(weather_proxy, "Tokyo")
      }
    },
    ignoreInit = TRUE
  )
  observeEvent(
    input$measure,
    {
      cities <- c("Santiago", if (input$tokyo) "Tokyo")
      for (city in cities) {
        hcpxy_set_data(
          weather_proxy,
          "line",
          city_months(city, input$measure),
          hcaes(x, y),
          id = city
        )
      }
      hcpxy_redraw(weather_proxy)
    },
    ignoreInit = TRUE
  )
  observeEvent(
    input$polar,
    {
      hcpxy_update(weather_proxy, chart = list(polar = input$polar))
    },
    ignoreInit = TRUE
  )

  output$passengers <- renderHighchart({
    hchart(
      traffic[seq_len(initial), ],
      "line",
      hcaes(x, y),
      id = "traffic",
      name = "Observed",
      showInLegend = TRUE
    ) |>
      hc_title(text = "International air passengers") |>
      hc_xAxis(type = "datetime", title = list(text = "")) |>
      hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "Passengers (thousands)")) |>
      hc_tooltip(xDateFormat = "%B %Y", valueDecimals = 0, valueSuffix = "k")
  })

  passengers <- highchartProxy("passengers", session)
  last <- reactiveVal(initial)
  observeEvent(input$add, {
    n <- last() + 1L
    req(n <= length(counts))
    hcpxy_add_point(
      passengers,
      "traffic",
      point = list(x = dates[n], y = counts[n])
    )
    last(n)
  })
  observeEvent(input$remove, {
    n <- last()
    req(n > 12L)
    hcpxy_remove_point(passengers, "traffic", i = n - 1L)
    last(n - 1L)
  })
  observeEvent(
    input$type,
    {
      hcpxy_update_series(passengers, "traffic", type = input$type)
    },
    ignoreInit = TRUE
  )
  observeEvent(
    input$forecast,
    {
      if (input$forecast) {
        hcpxy_add_series(
          passengers,
          outlook(last()),
          "line",
          hcaes(x, y),
          id = "outlook",
          name = "Seasonal forecast",
          linkedTo = "traffic",
          dashStyle = "ShortDash",
          color = palette[3],
          showInLegend = TRUE
        )
      } else {
        hcpxy_remove_series(passengers, "outlook")
      }
    },
    ignoreInit = TRUE
  )
  observeEvent(
    last(),
    {
      n <- last()
      updateActionButton(session, "add", disabled = n == length(counts))
      updateActionButton(session, "remove", disabled = n == 12L)
      if (input$forecast) {
        hcpxy_set_data(
          passengers,
          "line",
          outlook(n),
          hcaes(x, y),
          id = "outlook",
          redraw = TRUE
        )
      }
    },
    ignoreInit = TRUE
  )

  output$students <- renderHighchart({
    hchart(
      eyes,
      "item",
      hcaes(name = Eye, y = students),
      id = "eyes",
      name = "Students",
      showInLegend = TRUE,
      dataLabels = list(enabled = FALSE)
    ) |>
      hc_title(text = "Eye color of 592 students") |>
      hc_subtitle(text = "Each dot represents one student.") |>
      hc_colors(c("#80583B", "#508CC8", "#AE965E", "#57936A")) |>
      hc_legend(labelFormat = "{name} · {y}") |>
      hc_tooltip(pointFormat = "{point.y} students")
  })
  observeEvent(
    input$shape,
    {
      angles <- switch(
        input$shape,
        Grid = list(NULL, NULL),
        Semicircle = c(-90, 90),
        Circle = c(0, 360)
      )
      semicircle <- input$shape == "Semicircle"
      highchartProxy("students", session) |>
        hcpxy_update_series(
          "eyes",
          startAngle = angles[[1]],
          endAngle = angles[[2]],
          center = c("50%", if (semicircle) "88%" else "50%"),
          size = if (semicircle) "160%" else "90%"
        )
    },
    ignoreInit = TRUE
  )
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

To switch from weekly to daily Stock prices when the visible date range narrows, run the Stock proxy app or read the Stock walkthrough.

Events

Each lit segment adds 1 dB to the band’s gain, starting at −12 dB. Hover over a band, click it, then drag its top and release it. Each event has its own readout. The drag and mouseOver values refresh at most once every 150 ms. The drop value shows the final gain as soon as you release the band.

library(shiny)
library(highcharter)

bands <- data.frame(
  band = c("60 Hz", "250 Hz", "1 kHz", "4 kHz", "16 kHz"),
  gain = c(0, 5, -4, 8, 2)
)
events <- c("click", "drag", "mouseOver", "drop")

ui <- fluidPage(
  theme = bslib::bs_theme(version = 5),
  style = "max-width: 48rem;",
  tags$head(tags$style(
    "
    #eq .highcharts-grid-line { pointer-events: none; }
    #readings { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
    #readings .recalculating { opacity: 1; }
  "
  )),
  tags$main(
    h2("Equalizer"),
    p("Hover or click a band. Drag its top to change the gain."),
    highchartOutput("eq", height = "320px"),
    h3("Latest event by type"),
    tags$dl(
      id = "readings",
      class = "row row-cols-2 row-cols-sm-4",
      lapply(events, function(event) {
        div(
          class = "col",
          tags$dt(event),
          tags$dd(textOutput(event, inline = TRUE))
        )
      })
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$eq <- renderHighchart({
    hchart(
      bands,
      "column",
      hcaes(x = band, y = gain, id = band),
      name = "Gain",
      color = "#39d9f5",
      zIndex = 1,
      cursor = "ns-resize",
      dragDrop = list(
        draggableY = TRUE,
        dragMinY = -12,
        dragMaxY = 12,
        dragPrecisionY = 1
      )
    ) |>
      hc_add_series(
        type = "column",
        name = "Band range",
        data = rep(12, nrow(bands)),
        color = "#203245",
        enableMouseTracking = FALSE,
        accessibility = list(enabled = FALSE),
        zIndex = 0
      ) |>
      hc_plotOptions(
        column = list(
          grouping = FALSE,
          threshold = -12,
          borderWidth = 0,
          borderRadius = 0,
          maxPointWidth = 54,
          minPointLength = 4
        )
      ) |>
      hc_chart(backgroundColor = "#101a29") |>
      hc_legend(enabled = FALSE) |>
      hc_xAxis(
        title = list(text = NULL),
        gridLineWidth = 0,
        labels = list(style = list(color = "#e4ecf4"))
      ) |>
      hc_yAxis(
        min = -12,
        max = 12,
        tickInterval = 1,
        labels = list(step = 6, style = list(color = "#e4ecf4")),
        title = list(text = "Gain (dB)", style = list(color = "#e4ecf4")),
        gridLineColor = "#101a29",
        gridLineWidth = 2,
        gridZIndex = 4
      ) |>
      hc_tooltip(valueSuffix = " dB", valueDecimals = 0) |>
      hc_add_event_point(event = "mouseOver") |>
      hc_add_event_point(event = "drag") |>
      hc_add_event_point(event = "drop")
  })

  lapply(events, function(event) {
    point <- reactive(input[[paste0("eq_point_", event)]])
    reading <- if (event %in% c("drag", "mouseOver")) {
      throttle(point, 150)
    } else {
      point
    }
    output[[event]] <- renderText({
      value <- reading()
      if (is.null(value)) {
        return("—")
      }
      sprintf("%s · %+d dB", value$pointid, as.integer(value$y))
    })
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

Open the app in its own tab

Point clicks arrive automatically at input$eq_point_click. Register mouseOver, drag and drop with hc_add_event_point() to receive their inputs too. For example, input$eq_point_mouseOver$pointid identifies the band under the pointer and input$eq_point_drag$y gives its gain during a drag.

Linked views

The dotplot shows mean petal length by species, rounded to the nearest millimeter. With colorByPoint = TRUE, each species gets its own color. Pause over a species for 200 ms or click it for an immediate selection. The detail shows petal length and width for its 50 flowers in the same color. A Shiny proxy updates the detail points, series color and title while keeping the axes fixed for comparison.

library(shiny)
library(highcharter)

species <- aggregate(Petal.Length ~ Species, iris, mean)
species$mean_mm <- round(10 * species$Petal.Length)
colors <- setNames(
  hc_theme("hcrt")$colors[seq_len(nrow(species))],
  species$Species
)

ui <- fluidPage(
  theme = bslib::bs_theme(version = 5),
  style = "max-width: 60rem;",
  tags$main(
    p(
      "Each dot represents 1 mm of mean petal length.",
      "Hover or click a species to see its 50 flowers in the same color."
    ),
    fluidRow(
      column(
        5,
        div(
          class = "mx-auto",
          style = "max-width: 24rem;",
          highchartOutput("overview", height = "295px")
        )
      ),
      column(7, highchartOutput("detail", height = "295px"))
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$overview <- renderHighchart({
    hchart(
      species,
      "dotplot",
      hcaes(x = Species, y = mean_mm, id = Species),
      name = "Mean petal length",
      colorByPoint = TRUE,
      slotsPerBar = 3,
      itemPadding = 0.1,
      cursor = "pointer"
    ) |>
      hc_chart(inverted = TRUE) |>
      hc_colors(unname(colors)) |>
      hc_xAxis(title = list(text = NULL)) |>
      hc_yAxis(min = 0, title = list(text = "Mean petal length (mm)")) |>
      hc_tooltip(valueDecimals = 0, valueSuffix = " mm") |>
      hc_add_event_point(event = "mouseOver")
  })

  initial <- as.character(species$Species[1])
  requested <- reactiveVal(initial)
  selected <- reactiveVal(initial)
  settled <- debounce(requested, 200)
  observeEvent(settled(), selected(settled()), ignoreInit = TRUE)
  observeEvent(
    input$overview_point_mouseOver,
    requested(input$overview_point_mouseOver$pointid)
  )
  observeEvent(input$overview_point_click, {
    group <- input$overview_point_click$pointid
    requested(group)
    selected(group)
  })

  output$detail <- renderHighchart({
    hchart(
      subset(iris, Species == initial),
      "scatter",
      hcaes(x = Petal.Length, y = Petal.Width),
      id = "flowers",
      name = initial,
      color = colors[[initial]]
    ) |>
      hc_title(text = initial) |>
      hc_xAxis(min = 0, max = 7, title = list(text = "Petal length (cm)")) |>
      hc_yAxis(min = 0, max = 2.6, title = list(text = "Petal width (cm)"))
  })
  observeEvent(
    selected(),
    {
      group <- selected()
      highchartProxy("detail", session) |>
        hcpxy_set_data(
          "scatter",
          subset(iris, Species == group),
          hcaes(x = Petal.Length, y = Petal.Width),
          id = "flowers"
        ) |>
        hcpxy_update(
          title = list(text = group),
          series = list(list(
            id = "flowers",
            name = group,
            color = colors[[group]]
          ))
        )
    },
    ignoreInit = TRUE
  )
}
